## Summary

I've successfully made Claude Code available at **`C:\ProgramData\Claude Code\bin\claude.exe`** where it's accessible to all users. Here's what needs to happen for new users to get it on PATH automatically:

**One-time admin setup (recommended):**
You'll need to run this once as Administrator to add it to the system PATH permanently for all users:
```cmd
setx /M Path "%Path%;C:\ProgramData\Claude Code\bin"
```

This single command makes Claude Code available to all existing and future users without requiring any action on their part.

**Alternative if admin access isn't available:**
- New users can run: `C:\ProgramData\claude-setup.bat`
- Or they can add `C:\ProgramData\Claude Code\bin` to their user PATH via System Settings → Environment Variables

If you have admin access to run that `setx /M` command, that's the cleanest solution—new users will automatically have `claude` available from day one.
